theorem ChoquetProduct.exists_dense_isGdelta_fiber_witness.{v, u} {Y : Type v} [TopologicalSpace Y] {X : Type u}
  [TopologicalSpace X] [BaireSpace X] (σ : ChoquetProduct.SecondStrategy Y) (hσ : ChoquetProduct.SecondWins Y σ)
  (D : Nat → Set (Prod X Y)) (hDo : ∀ (n : Nat), IsOpen (D n)) (hDd : ∀ (n : Nat), Dense (D n)) {V : Set Y}
  (hVo : IsOpen V) (hVn : Set.Nonempty V) :
  Exists fun G =>
    And (IsGδ G)
      (And (Dense G)
        (∀ (x : X),
          Membership.mem G x →
            Exists fun y => And (Membership.mem V y) (∀ (n : Nat), Membership.mem (D n) (Prod.mk x y))))
audit_declarations.name: ChoquetProduct.exists_dense_isGdelta_fiber_witness
